draft.title: The New Economic Policy
card: By 1921 the Russian economy was in ruins and peasants were rebelling. The Kronstadt sailors' revolt in March 1921 added to the pressure on Lenin.
The New Economic Policy (NEP) was introduced in 1921. It ended the forced taking of grain and let peasants sell surplus food for profit, after paying a tax in kind.
Small businesses and private trade were allowed again. The state kept control of the "commanding heights": large industry, banking and foreign trade.
The NEP helped food and goods return, but it divided the Communist Party. Some members saw it as a necessary pause, and others saw it as a retreat from socialist ideas.
draft.remember: The NEP traded some state control for recovery, and the Party argued over whether that was wise.

a.q: Which change did the NEP make to the way the state dealt with peasants?
opts: It replaced grain seizures with a tax and allowed sales
It gave peasants control of all large factories
It ended all private farming and trade across Russia
It made peasants hand over all their grain to the state
a.why: Peasants paid a tax in kind and could then sell any surplus for profit. Forced seizure of grain belonged to the earlier policy, and the NEP ended it.
a.clue: Think about what peasants could do with food left over after the tax.

b.q: In 1923, a Bolshevik member criticises the NEP while the state still owns Russia's largest factories and banks. What is the best reason for the criticism?
opts: Private trade and profit seemed to betray socialist ideals
The state had given up control of all heavy industry
The policy had failed to bring any food back to the cities
The policy had been forced on Lenin by the Whites
b.why: Critics saw profit-making traders and farmers as a retreat from socialism, which is why the Party was divided. The state kept the largest industry, banks and foreign trade, so the claim that it gave up heavy industry is wrong.
b.clue: Consider what the state kept, and what it gave up.

a.best: It replaced grain seizures with a tax and allowed sales

b.best: Private trade and profit seemed to betray socialist ideals
